## Why it matters

arCHeco is a directory of business and economic archive holdings in Switzerland and Liechtenstein, with advanced search across fonds, institutions, places, and sectors.

It helps researchers locate corporate, association, and personal economic archives even when the records remain dispersed across many repositories.
